items.statement: Within the stated model and computational boundary, the validated profile supports endo-OCM as the preferred initiating OCM and supports a cycloisomerization path whose overall barrier is about 22.8 kcal/mol.
items.expected: The report concludes that endo-OCM is preferred, gives the requested barrier comparison, and limits the claim to the modeled Rh/1D system.

items.statement: The result is a model-system computational conclusion subject to conformational and method sensitivity.
items.expected: The report states model-system scope and uncertainty rather than presenting the computed profile as an unrestricted experimental rate prediction.
